messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D story-mode dueling game inspired by Riposte, with sci-fi robots, a new level, and a new mechanic.

## Requirements
- Replace the characters and environment with sci-fi robots and settings.
- Make the game 3D, playable, and structured as story-mode levels.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them at finish.

## Decisions
- Created “RIPOSTE: AFTERLIGHT” as a browser-based Three.js game with three story chapters.
- Added “Phase Shift,” a charge-powered dash that follows a perfect parry and amplifies the next strike.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the game UI, Three.js arena, robot fighters, combat, chapter progression, story dialogue, keyboard and touch controls, and synthesized sound effects.
- Added chapter-specific environments and enemy types.
- Added `favicon.svg`; verified the title and gameplay render in Chromium screenshots.

### Active
- Validate gameplay behavior: after starting and waiting five seconds, Playwright reported `hp: "100%"`, `target: "SCANNING"`, and no attack prompt; investigate why enemy AI appears not to be progressing.
- Review/fix any gameplay issues, rerun browser checks, and summarize assumptions and controls for the user.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Diagnose the enemy AI state/timer progression and ensure opponents attack and can be parried.
2. Test movement, strikes, parries, Phase Shift, chapter transitions, and mobile controls in-browser.
3. Check `git status`, then report the completed game and reasonable assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Three.js scene, robot models, combat loop, enemy AI, progression, input.
- `index.html`: Game HUD, story cards, dialogue, controls, touch UI.
- `style.css`: Responsive visual design and layout.
- `favicon.svg`: Custom game icon.
- `screenshots/gameplay.png`: Captured initial gameplay screen.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
